thread:
jamie: Heads up — external pentest inbound next Wed (vendor booked). Need to lock down RBAC changes, KMS access model, and a reproducible evidence export for triage + retest. Who can own the access plan and evidence vault format?

maria: I can own the access plan. Quick clarifying qs: scope = staging + subset of prod logs for auth flows (no PII). Confirm? Also need a timeline for ephemeral creds.

dan: Confirmed scope sounds right. For RBAC I suggest creating scoped service-roles rather than user grants. Example minimal policy for assessor-runner: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-logs/*"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/pt-access-key"]
    }
  ]
}```

luis: For KMS, we should not hand over key materials. Use envelope encryption: we export logs encrypted to the evidence-vault S3 bucket using the PT KMS key. Assessor gets temporary role to read that bucket. We need an auditable signing step for artifacts (SHA256). Example packaging step: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging/logs/pt-session.tgz ./ && shasum -a 256 pt-session.tgz > pt-session.tgz.sha256
aws s3 cp pt-session.tgz s3://redwood-evidence-vault/PT-4523/
aws s3 cp pt-session.tgz.sha256 s3://redwood-evidence-vault/PT-4523/```

olivia: Product note — retest window we promised the client is 2 weeks after report fixes. Proposed dates: initial test Wed, draft report Fri, fixes sprint next week, retest window start in two weeks. Aligns with legal's SLA.

jamie: Owners: maria -> access plan + ephemeral role creation, dan -> IAM policies and deployment of scoped roles, luis -> evidence packaging + checksums, olivia -> stakeholder comms and retest cadence. I filed PT ticket PT-4523 and added checklist. Please add any blockers to PT-4523.

dan: On audit logging: export CloudTrail+application auth logs into the evidence-vault with object tagging (pt=4523, assessor=acme). Retention for exported objects = 90 days. Use lifecycle rule to move to Glacier after 30 days. Command to bulk-export (example): ```bash
aws logs create-export-task --task-name pt-4523-export --from <start-ms> --to <end-ms> --log-group-name /aws/app/auth --destination redwood-evidence-vault --destination-prefix PT-4523/auth````

maria: For ephemeral creds we'll use AWS STS with a 4hr max session. We'll create a small playbook for on-call to generate/readroom creds. Quick test command to validate role perms: ```bash
kubectl auth can-i get pods --as=assessor-role -n prod-auth````

deploy-bot: role-grant: created role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-4523-assessor-role (expires in 4h) — please verify access and report any missing permissions.

luis: Verified I can read the evidence bucket with the role. One ask: include a metadata manifest in JSON inside each evidence folder with sha256 and an audit log pointer. Example manifest: `\{"files\":[\{"path\":\"auth/pt-session.tgz\",\"sha256\":\"<value>\"\}],\"exported_by\":\"logs-exporter\",\"export_ts\":\"2026-03-24T15:32:00Z\"}`

jamie: Perfect. Next steps: maria will publish the access playbook by EOD, dan to push IAM changes to staging by tomorrow noon, luis to run an end-to-end export and drop artifacts in PT-4523 folder, olivia will confirm retest slot. Sync standup 11am tomorrow to sign off. :thumbsup:
